# Kajol Phadnis

> Kajol Phadnis is an ex-Deloitte management consultant (Associate Director) who now runs customer experience for 70+ US and UK retail and consumer brands in the Middle East. kajolphadnis.com covers getting promoted and building a career in consulting and corporate, plus her consulting and coaching services. Based between London and Dubai.

## Products

- [The Promotion Case Template](https://www.kajolphadnis.com/promotion-case-template): editable 12-slide PowerPoint (.pptx) for building the business case for your promotion, with two formats. For analysts and consultants going for Consultant or Manager. £9.99, instant download. Also works in Google Slides and Keynote.
- [Corporate Toolkit & Templates](https://www.kajolphadnis.com/toolkit): the template above, two free diagnostics, and templates on the way.

## Free tools

- [Promotion Blocker Diagnostic](https://www.kajolphadnis.com/promotion-blocker-diagnostic): two-minute quiz identifying what is blocking your promotion (visibility, sponsorship, scope or the ask).
- [Stuck Type Diagnostic](https://www.kajolphadnis.com/stuck-type-diagnostic): two-minute quiz on why you feel stuck at work.
